en.title: DIMI
en.description: The DIMI is a display unit designed for mines and quarries. It provides simple, accurate monitoring of mast inclination on 2 axes. Combined with a NORMA2, it also monitors azimuth on 3 axes.

blocks.html: The DIMI is a display unit designed for mines and quarries. It provides simple, accurate monitoring of mast inclination on 2 axes. Combined with a NORMA2, it also monitors azimuth on 3 axes.

items: Dedicated display for monitoring mast inclination on 2 axes
Azimuth monitoring on 3 axes when combined with a NORMA2
Clear colour interface suited to jobsite conditions
Display and monitoring device: the DIMI has no recording function

es.title: DIMI
es.description: El DIMI es una unidad de visualización diseñada para minas y canteras. Ofrece un control sencillo y preciso de la inclinación del mástil en 2 ejes. Combinado con un NORMA2, también controla el acimut en 3 ejes.
